name: Akai APC mini mk2
source: APC mini mk2 Communication Protocol (Akai Professional): pad notes, the LED channels for brightness and animation, the colour table, faders.
notes: Unverified: written from the protocol document, not yet tried on a device. The pads have no velocity. The faders are the encoders (the master fader is left out). It has no mode buttons, so it stays in Session mode.
